records.jp: お前は、本当の私じゃない
records.en_original: You are not the real me.
records.en_auxiliary: You are not the real me.
records.en: You are not the real me.
I can hear my own voice...

records.jp: 「あなたもそうでしょう？」と言われて、<CR>私がそう思っていたことなんて一度もない
records.en_original: Never once have I felt sympathy when asked to put myself in another's place.
records.en_auxiliary: Never once have I felt sympathy when asked to put myself in another's place.
records.en: When someone says, 'You feel the same way, right?'<CR>I've never once felt that way.

records.jp: 「人の気持ちを考えるのは当たり前」
records.en_original: Think about how they would feel.
records.en_auxiliary: Think about how they would feel.
records.en: "It's only natural to think about how other people feel."

records.jp: 「おばあちゃんの家に遊びに行くのは嬉しいこと」
records.en_original: You should be happy to visit your grandmother.
records.en_auxiliary: You should be happy to visit your grandmother.
records.en: "Going to visit Grandma is something to be happy about."
Why, you ask? Don't you feel the same?

records.jp: ねえ、“私”。あなたは私なんだから、<CR>よく分かるでしょう？
records.en_original: You understand, don't you? You are me, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: You understand, don't you? You are me, after all.
records.en: Tell me, 'me.' You're me, so you understand,<CR>don't you?

records.jp: 料理を作るだの、学校を歩き回るだの、<CR>あんな生温い人生は“私”じゃない
records.en_original: That person who helps with the cooking, who walks with her friends around campus... I was never so soft.
records.en_auxiliary: That person who helps with the cooking, who walks with her friends around campus... I was never so soft.
records.en: Cooking meals, walking around the school...<CR>That lukewarm life isn't 'me.'

records.jp: 私は他の人間とは決定的に違う
records.en_original: I am not like the others.
records.en_auxiliary: I am not like the others.
records.en: I'm fundamentally different from other people.

records.jp: 私は最初から壊れている
records.en_original: I was broken from the very beginning.
records.en_auxiliary: I was broken from the very beginning.
records.en: I was broken from the very beginning.

records.jp: ほら、戻りましょう？<CR>苛烈で、刺激的で、色鮮やかな人生に
records.en_original: Why don't we go back to the way we were? Back to our exciting, crazy, colorful life.
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we go back to the way we were? Back to our exciting, crazy, colorful life.
records.en: Come on. Let's go back<CR>to a fierce, exciting, colorful life.

records.jp: 思い出して。あの日――通り魔にあって、<CR>私の人生は変わったの
records.en_original: Remember. That day changed us forever. That day we were attacked.
records.en_auxiliary: Remember. That day changed us forever. That day we were attacked.
records.en: Remember. That day—a random attacker<CR>changed my life.

records.jp: 嘘、通り魔……！？　太もも、切られてる……！！
records.en_original: No way... A slasher?! Your leg's cut!
records.en_auxiliary: No way... A slasher?! Your leg's cut!
records.en: No way, a random attacker...?! Your thigh has been cut...!!

records.jp: こんなに血が……！？<CR>け、警察に連絡しないと――！
records.en_original: There's so much blood... I-I've got to call the police!
records.en_auxiliary: There's so much blood... I-I've got to call the police!
records.en: There's so much blood...<CR>I-I've got to call the police!

records.jp: 痛い！！　ちゃんと、痛い……！！
私は……私はおかしくない！<CR>私も生きている！　私もちゃんと、人間なんだ！
records.en_original: There's nothing wrong with me! I'm alive! I'm a real, living human being!
records.en_auxiliary: There's nothing wrong with me! I'm alive! I'm a real, living human being!
records.en: I'm not strange!<CR>I'm alive too! I'm a real human being!

records.jp: あはは、あははははははははははははは！！！！
みんな！　気を付けて！<CR>何か――何か起きてる！！
records.en_original: Everybody, be careful! Something... Something's happening!
records.en_auxiliary: Everybody, be careful! Something... Something's happening!

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続にｓ失敗しししっｓｍあｍした
うっ、ぐ…………<CR>うぁあああああああああああああああああああっ！！
これ、まずいんじゃない！？
……ごめん、もし暴れるようなら、私は……！
records.en_original: If she's going to hurt us, I have to—
records.en_auxiliary: If she's going to hurt us, I have to—
records.en: ...I'm sorry, but if she gets violent, I'll...!

records.jp: あ、愛央ちゃん！　このままじゃまずいよ……っ！
records.en_original: A-Ao! We need to get out of here!
records.en_auxiliary: A-Ao! We need to get out of here!

records.en_original: Let's hurry back to the school for now!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's hurry back to the school for now!
records.en: Let's hurry back to the school for now!

records.jp: 肩持って！　行くよ、せーのっ――
